gatingQuestion: Normalize XTND post-merger basic and fully diluted shares, pre-funded-warrant and equity-plan overhang, cash runway and financing dependence without double counting rollover or awards.
whyItMatters: The open Chief directive forbids admission, score or opportunity state until capitalization/runway is reconciled from primary evidence.
preferredPrimarySource: XTND September 3, 2026 closing Form 8-K12B and incorporated closing exhibits/pro forma financial information.
lawfulFallbacks: Effective Form S-4/A and filed exhibits
Subsequent XTND SEC periodic/current reports that disclose actual post-close shares, warrants, plan reserve or cash flows
successCondition: Primary filings support a reconciled post-close capitalization/runway view with dilution percentages and no double counting of rollover/plan awards.

facts: 27,544,248 pre-funded warrants to purchase XTND common stock were actually issued in the redomestication.
Former Xtend holders owned 79.61% and former JFB holders 20.39% of fully diluted economic ownership immediately after closing.

JFB options/RSUs and Xtend options rolled into XTND awards; the filing separately describes substantial new 2026 Plan RSU grants, some contingent on a January 1, 2027 increase in shares available under the plan.
XTND became guarantor of Xtend obligations under the amended Bank Hapoalim facility.
Closing mechanics included cash exercise of warrants for 3,328,407 shares at $2.875 and 16,137,866 shares at $3.125 plus cashless exercise producing 6,999,928 shares.
The closing pro forma states ownership percentages on a fully diluted basis excluding amounts reserved under the New PubCo equity incentive plan.

Pre-close illustrative capitalization expected about 253,820,525 common shares, 24,872,729 pre-funded warrants and 36,183,289 shares reserved for converted options, but those figures were explicitly assumption-based and were superseded in part by actual closing mechanics.

Transaction minimum closing cash was reduced from $110 million to $60 million; management described total transaction proceeds including PIPE and SAFE investments as approximately $100 million rather than approximately $150 million.

evidenceVsInference.evidence: Actual closing filing fixes the pre-funded-warrant issuance at 27,544,248 and documents the warrant exercises, rollover awards, new-plan grants, ownership split and financing facility.
evidenceVsInference.inference: A single exact fully diluted denominator cannot be safely reconstructed by simply adding the pre-close illustrative common, warrant and option figures because the closing filing changed the pre-funded-warrant count, uses ownership percentages excluding plan reserves, and includes rolled and newly granted/contingent awards with differing treatment. Cash runway also cannot be normalized from transaction gross proceeds alone without a post-close cash-flow/balance-sheet bridge.

contradictionStatus.details: The actual 27,544,248 pre-funded warrants differ from the 24,872,729 pre-close illustrative amount. The available primary filings do not expose, in one reconciled actual-closing table, the exact common shares outstanding plus every economically dilutive rolled option/RSU, plan reserve and contingent grant. The old provisional 277,442,600 denominator therefore must not be treated as an exact actual fully diluted count.

gateImpact: BLOCK exact capitalization/runway normalization. Do not admit, score or assign opportunity state from the provisional denominator. Preserve actual known closing components separately and await Chief conservative/block disposition or a later primary filing with an actual post-close capitalization and cash-flow bridge.
attemptDisposition: Third targeted attempt. Material primary evidence was recovered, but the success condition remains unmet. Per deep-resolver rules, preserve the exact unavailable reconciliation and stop repeated unchanged research until a new primary filing or Chief-directed evidence path exists.
